notes: <WAH0834> in UNV's 所 is represented indirectly in LCC's reordered phrase 滋生在水中, so it is attached to 在 as the closest functional equivalent.
Rule 3 applied for {<WAH03588>}: LCC makes the clause explicit with 這, so the braces are dropped and the tag is attached normally.
LCC's 有翅膀的鳥兒 expands UNV's 飛鳥, so <WH03671> attaches to 有翅膀 and <WH05775> to 鳥兒.
The second 又創造 in LCC is left untagged because the Hebrew has only one occurrence of ברא in this verse; the repeated Chinese verb is translational expansion.
